protocol.rejection: reject iff maximum leaf cosine < frozen threshold; identical leaf predictions and mask across parent arms
protocol.calibration: validation known/hidden binary labels only. Candidates -1, sorted distinct validation scores, nextafter(max,+infinity). equal-leaf-mean: normalize equal-weight mean of normalized known child-leaf prototypes; max cosine over supported parents, ties lexicographic opaque parent ID
protocol.prediction_boundary: score all test predictions and shared rejection mask once with frozen validation threshold before any test gold scoring; no query-dependent reranking, online updating or test tuning
protocol.metrics: validation and test separate; hidden all-row parent accuracy and joint reject+correct-parent, conditional parent accuracy among rejected with numerator/denominator; parent-macro averages over gold parents with hidden queries; known leaf accuracy, acceptance coverage and false novelty, conditional accepted correctness; all plus gold-parent one/multiple supported-child strata
